quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap neutralizing €1.43B in goodwill and acquired intangibles from Bluebeam and GoCanvas (unadjusted tangible ROIC >100% vs reported GAAP ROIC 29.1%). Stellar 156% multi-year cash conversion with minimal net leverage (0.49x Net Debt/NI) and 15.9x interest coverage. 5-10Y forward growth of 9.5% underpinned by the Bluebeam and BIM SaaS subscription transition (6.0%), annual contractual pricing uplifts (2.5%), and international expansion (1.0%), moderating for cyclical commercial construction drag (-0.5%).
